newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle quiet, no trade - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle quiet, no trade - USDA.

text.p: Trade was at a standstill in the Panhandle area Monday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers not tested. Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers. No trade reported on slaughter steers or heifers.
The last established price was $63.00 per cwt on Friday. Monday's packer bids were $62.00-$63.00, with asking prices mostly $65.00-$66.00.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Confirmed - None Week Ago - 18,600 Year Ago - 100
Wk to Date - 2,800 Week Ago - 19,700 Year Ago - 16,600
